en.basel-kadem: 3.	My father, may Allah grant him mercy, said: We were told by Sa’d bin Abdullah, from Ahmad bin Abi Abdillah, from Ali ibn Maysara, from Abu Ziyad al-Makki, that he said: I heard Abu’l-Hasan, peace be upon him, say:
None rejects generosity except for a donkey. By that he meant (that one is offered) perfume and a pillow.
